title: 3. File Upload Vulnerabilities
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L11: Web Security 2 (XSS · CSRF · Files · SSRF · API · Proactive Controls): 3. File Upload Vulnerabilities.

items: Extension blocklist bypass — shell.php.jpg, shell.PhP, shell.php5, shell.phtml
MIME type spoofing — set Content-Type: image/png while uploading PHP
Magic byte injection — prepend valid PNG header to a PHP file
Polyglots — file is valid PNG and valid PHP
Validate magic bytes server-side — file command or library, not user-supplied MIME
Rename uploads to UUIDs — strip user filename entirely
Store outside webroot OR serve via separate domain with Content-Disposition: attachment
Disable script execution in upload directory — Apache php_admin_flag engine off
Size limits — both at app and reverse proxy
